cases.question: Tornado warning in Midland County. Triage critical lifeline infrastructure: count hospital hexes and substation hexes in high tornado risk zones. Report resource gap.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT T1."hex_id") AS hospital_hex_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT T2."hex_id") AS substation_hex_count,
  (COUNT(DISTINCT T1."hex_id") - COUNT(DISTINCT T2."hex_id")) AS resource_gap
FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" AS C
JOIN "HP_TOR_001" AS T ON C."hex_id" = T."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" AS T1 ON C."hex_id" = T1."hex_id" AND T1."hifld_health_hospitals_n" > 0
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" AS T2 ON C."hex_id" = T2."hex_id" AND T2."hifld_energy_substations_n" > 0
WHERE C."County" = 'Midland'
  AND T."nri_tornado" > (SELECT AVG("nri_tornado") FROM "HP_TOR_001");
```

cases.reforce_sql:
SELECT
  T1."hex_id",
  T1."nri_eal_HRCN" AS "Hurricane_Risk",
  T2."nri_eal_RFLD" AS "Riverine_Flood_Risk",
  T3."nri_eal_WFIR" AS "Wildfire_Risk",
  T4."sovi" AS "Social_Vulnerability",
  T5."hifld_health_hospitals_n" AS "Hospital_Count",
  T6."hifld_water_wtp_n" AS "Water_Treatment_Plants"
FROM "VUL_003" AS T1
JOIN "VUL_003" AS T2 ON T1."hex_id" = T2."hex_id"
JOIN "VUL_003" AS T3 ON T1."hex_id" = T3."hex_id"
JOIN "VUL_002" AS T4 ON T1."hex_id" = T4."hex_id"
JOIN "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" AS T5 ON T1."hex_id" = T5."hex_id"
JOIN "HIFLD-WATER-WTP-N" AS T6 ON T1."hex_id" = T6."hex_id"
ORDER BY (T1."nri_eal_HRCN" + T2."nri_eal_RFLD" + T3."nri_eal_WFIR") * T4."sovi" DESC
LIMIT 10;
